narrative.overview: Genix uses flat rounded egui surfaces inspired by iOS 18, as explicitly requested by the user. Soft neutral containers, the existing Genix SVG logo and one configurable accent connect account pages, model cards and the CAD editor. This is an egui implementation, not native iOS components.
keyCharacteristics: Flat neutral surfaces with rounded controls and containers.
One configurable accent propagated through navigation, tools and feedback.
Real geometry previews and immediate keyboard actions.
dos: Do use theme helpers for the configured accent and contrasting foreground.
Do preserve real geometry previews, the Genix logo and existing CAD workflows.
Do provide immediate keyboard actions and honor the app reduced-motion preference.
Do keep local mock account and subscription status visible.
donts: Don't hard-code the old blue accent into new UI.
Don't claim native iOS controls or automatic OS reduced-motion detection.
Don't invent subscription pricing, storage promises or update availability.
